editorial:
Imagine a city that feels like a dark, moody dream where a rich guy spends his nights fighting crime in a heavy rubber suit. You get to follow Bruce Wayne, a man who never got over the loss of his parents and decides to take the fight to the streets as Batman. The vibe here is totally unique because it mixes a comic book world with a gothic, spooky style. You will love how the city of Gotham feels like its own character, filled with strange buildings and foggy alleys that make the whole experience feel like a ride through a dark carnival.

Jack Nicholson steals the show as the Joker, bringing a wild energy that makes every scene pop. While some of the special effects look a bit old now, the acting and the music keep you glued to your seat. It is a great pick if you want a classic hero story that does not take itself too seriously. To get the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp colors. If you are a real fan, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go.
endingExplained: The movie ends with a huge showdown at the Gotham Cathedral. Batman fights the Joker in a final battle on the roof. After a tough struggle, Batman manages to knock the Joker off the building, and he falls to his death. Bruce Wayne keeps his secret identity safe, and he finally finds some peace. He stays the protector of the city, while Vicki Vale realizes that the hero she loves is real.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic comic book movies and gothic style.
